Potchi
is
an
interesting
one.
It’s
a
strawberry cream gummy candy and is one
of the only childhood classics I could never
seem to get tired of when I was younger,
which is wild considering I disliked sweets.
It’s
light,
puffy,
gummy,
and
sweet.
My
cousin Addy had an imaginary friend when
she
was
younger
named
“Potchi-Potchi”,
which we still tease her about to this day

— it seems I’m not the only person who

was fond of Potchi growing up. There
should be enough in the package;

feel free to share them with everyone
if you wish.
